## 17.3 Programme

Rename the existing paragraph as (a), and amend as follows:

In paragraph (a) of this Sub-Clause; the period referred to in Conditions of Contract is twenty-eight (28) days following the Efective Date. This defined period supersedes the stipulated period in the Gcncral requirements.

## Add the following paraqraphs(b) &(o):

- (b) The Programme must represent and fully respect the milestones of theschedule issued underAppendixD (if exists) formingpartof the Contractdocuments and all therequirementsofDivision1(General requirements)of TechnicalSpecifications.
